title: echo '=== full legacy_scenarios.rs (line counts + first 100) ===' && wc -l tools/mock-engine/src/legacy_scenarios.rs &&
command: echo '=== full legacy_scenarios.rs (line counts + first 100) ===' && wc -l tools/mock-engine/src/legacy_scenarios.rs && sed -n '1,80p' tools/mock-engine/src/legacy_scenarios.rs && echo '=== usage of bare json! macro outside inner mod ===' && grep -n 'json!' tools/mock-engine/src/legacy_scenarios.rs | head -30 && echo '=== build mock-engine for warnings ===' && cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && cargo build -p mock-engine --color=never 2>&1 | tail -40
